paper.title: Analysis of the background signal in Tianwen-1 MINPA
paper.local_data_limitation: Under the configured local root D:\Data\TW-1\result\MINPA\ori, Mode-1 coverage stops at 2022-01-01T05:48:33Z and resumes on 2022-02-28T23:29:14Z. This is a statement about the audited local copy, not mission-wide availability; no mission-data download is performed.

expanded_candidate_selection.purpose: Broader provisional pool for the manually calibrated pure-background reference classifier; predictions remain subject to review.

borderline_boundary_refinement.selection_rule: Among subwindows that pass the high-confidence spectral classifier, gross-coherence veto, and quality checks, retain the longest; break equal-duration ties by the lowest decision score. Discard the candidate if none pass at or above half duration.

coherent_signal_screen.interpretation: Reject if any H+ energy channel exceeds five count equivalents in at least 10% of records, or exceeds one count equivalent in at least 40%. The weak threshold is above the 0.27 maximum measured in this project's 23:10-23:20 window following the paper's around-23:10 quiet example.

quality_policy.reason: Sparse records and bit-5 high-channel records are retained under the relaxed policy; UV and alternating-channel errors remain hard vetoes.
